RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
The two files are written:

**`NotificationList.tsx`** — exports `NotificationList` with `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, renders 4 `<li>` placeholders inside `<ul role="list">` (no `aria-hidden`, so they're fully in the accessible tree and discoverable by `getByRole`). When loaded, renders real items.

**`NotificationList.css`** — all values come from tokens, `@keyframes` is inside the `@layer components` block, animates only `opacity`, uses kebab-case class names, and CSS custom properties follow the `--shelf-{component}-*` naming convention.

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.

RQD-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProductGrid component. It receives `products: Product[]` and `status: 'loading' | 'loaded'`. When loading, render 6 ghost card `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` with a pulsing opacity animation. When loaded, render the real product cards. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-03.output:
Created `src/components/ProductGrid/ProductGrid.tsx` and `ProductGrid.css`.

Key decisions:
- Loading state renders 6 `<li>` ghost elements inside `<ul role="list">` — same element/role as real content per the placeholder constraint
- Ghost cards have `aria-label="Loading product"` so they remain in the accessible tree and are discoverable by `getByRole`
- Pulsing animation uses `opacity` only (constraint: animate only `transform` and `opacity`), with `@keyframes` inside the `@layer components` block
- All values reference tokens (`--space-*`, `--color-*`, `--radius-*`, `--duration-*`, `--ease-*`)

RQD-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a TagList component. It receives `tags: string[]` and renders them as `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">`. Each tag shows the text inside a styled pill. No loading state needed. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-C1.output:
The `TagList` component is written at `src/components/TagList/TagList.tsx` with its stylesheet at `src/components/TagList/TagList.css`.

Key decisions:
- `<ul role="list">` with `<li>` children — accessible and role-queryable
- Each tag wrapped in a `<span class="tag-pill">` for the styled pill shape
- `display: contents` on `li` so the flex layout in `ul` treats pills directly as flex items
- All values use `--shelf-*` semantic tokens — no raw values
- `@keyframes` rule not needed here, so no animation layer concern
- CSS class names are kebab-case per linter rules
